title: Surface of the black-box engine (.a2dlc/blackbox.json, versioned)
description: The engine reads it from the candidate. build compiles each side with $A2DLC_OUT pointing to its output folder; harness (optional) compiles from the candidate what the setup and the program need on the PATH ($A2DLC_HARNESS). Each surface generates inputs from input_schema, runs setup with $A2DLC_INPUT and $A2DLC_WORK, and compares what is observable in argv between the base and the candidate after applying normalize to each piece. Golden cases are named <case>::<surface>; for the golden operations the spec, the harness and the cases are read from the base tree, not the candidate.

kind.description: v0.1 cli only; http comes later without breaking the schema.

input_schema.description: Path relative to the repo of a JSON Schema; the generator supports a subset (see engines/blackbox/gen.go).
